claims: Riolu Hatch Day in Pokémon GO is on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
Riolu Hatch Day in Pokémon GO runs from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM local time.
Riolu Hatch Day features increased 2km egg hatches.
Riolu Hatch Day features higher shiny rates for Riolu.
During Riolu Hatch Day, 2km eggs are more common from PokéStops.
Riolu hatches from 2km eggs during Riolu Hatch Day.
Riolu has a high probability of being Shiny during Riolu Hatch Day.
During Riolu Hatch Day, egg hatch distance is halved.
During Riolu Hatch Day, hatch candy is 2×.
During Riolu Hatch Day, hatch XP is 2×.
Free event Timed Research for Riolu Hatch Day rewards an Incubator.
Free Timed Research for Riolu Hatch Day includes event-themed Field Research.
A $1.99 USD ticket is available for extra Timed Research during Riolu Hatch Day.
The paid ticket provides extra incubators and a star piece.
